messages:
talia: Quick: hiring two engineers in APAC with start dates 12/27 and 1/03. We have a global year-end blackout 12/24-1/02. Managers asking if APAC hires who start 12/27 get paid holiday days and how carryover works across regions.
micah: Regional nuance: holiday/shutdown rules follow the company global shutdown dates for payroll tagging, but local public holidays are separate. If hire_date <= shutdown_start they get paid shutdown days; 12/27 is after 12/24 so they normally would not get the earlier days.
jamal: Follow-up: carryover eligibility is always based on active payroll status on 12/31 regardless of region, right? Managers worry APAC payroll cutoff differs.
hr-bot: POLICY CLIP: "Carryover eligibility: Employees on payroll as of Dec 31 in their employing legal entity are eligible for standard carryover up to the published cap. Company shutdown pay is applied based on the employing-entity payroll rules and hire date relative to the shutdown start."
payroll-bot: FYI: APAC payroll cutoff this year is Dec 30 for final payroll run. To be considered active on 12/31 for carryover, employee must be onboarded and tagged in payroll by Dec 30 cutoff. Submit onboarding docs early.
talia: Ah — so the 12/27 hire could miss the payroll tagging cutoff if onboarding isn't completed by Dec 30. That matters. Any workaround?
micah: Workaround: People Ops can request an "active-on-cutoff" tag for late hires if paperwork is complete; this requires manager confirmation and a payroll ticket by Dec 29 EOD. Not automatic.
jamal: What about the 1/03 hire? They definitely won't be eligible for shutdown pay and not for carryover this cycle since not active on 12/31. Managers should know for offers.
talia: OK I'll update offer language for APAC candidates: short note that shutdown pay and carryover depend on payroll cutoff for your country and to expect pro-rated accruals; managers must submit payroll-tag ticket for any exceptions. Will share draft. :+1:
micah: Also reminder: sick-day top-ups for onboarding during blackout are discretionary and require the checkbox in hiring checklist. If you want auto-grant for launch-critical APAC hires, we need to document criteria and get payroll tagging in advance.
talia: Draft posted -> https://redwood.internal/people-ops/faq/apac-shutdown-onboarding. Thanks team, will loop payroll for the 12/27 hire now.
